excerpt: The NA44 experiment has measured single particle inclusive spectra for charged pions, kaons, and protons as a function of transverse mass near mid-rapidity in 158 A GeV/c Pb+Pb collisions.
publisher: NA44 Collaboration / arXiv (Phys. Rev. C submission)
title: Particle production in central Pb+Pb collisions at 158 A GeV/c
